title: Inspect AI WRAP spike on EVS-TEST-SELECTION
summary: inspect-ai 0.3.272 installed in the isolated .agent-local/venv-dev (69 added packages; the venv's site-packages ~282 MB including earlier dev tools). A 33-line bridge (projects/personal-agent-os/research/prior-art/spikes/inspect_bridge.py) ran the 40 EVS-TEST-SELECTION cases as an Inspect task: dataset from the Agent OS case file, solver calling the deterministic import-graph route, scorer calling eval.score_test_selection, model mockllm (0 model calls). Result accuracy 0.375, identical to orchestrate eval (EVR-0007); 1.7 s; standard .eval log written. Inspect's distinctive value (Docker/Kubernetes sandboxes, inspect_evals benchmark ports) needs Docker or WSL, neither installed on this machine; its custom ModelAPI extension point exists for bridging Agent OS routes. Suite definitions, scoring rule and promotion stayed in Agent OS.
